spec.event_features: same player-only ordered features as temporal D HGB
spec.boundary_training: Existing train matches only; shared clean 5Hz player features; no SkillCorner event labels because its timings are censored
spec.boundary_target: Each directional transition within +/-0.2s; exclude neighborhoods touching unknowns or input block starts
spec.weighting: Equal provider, then match row mass; balanced event/non-event loss
spec.decoder: Original fps-scaled switch cost 3; H/A switches unchanged; event p>.5 linearly reduces only its directional dead/live penalty down to zero; no transition reward or minimum dwell
spec.control: dead_switch_cost_half halves all dead/live penalties without event evidence
spec.inference: Offline player observations only; no held-out labels used for features or decode
spec.baseline: Exact adopted pooled H/A ballgap25 checkpoint; existing GRU+ordered-HGB D checkpoints per fold
spec.evaluation: Official greedy spell F1 averaged over IoU .3,.4,.5,.6,.7; match means within provider then equal-provider means
spec.holdout_scope: D and boundary heads only; H/A pooled and source-exposed
spec.interpretation: Reused historical development data; no fresh independent broadcast confirmation
